choice.basis: On the state prevalence dashboard, the legend runs from pale yellow at the top (High, 100) to dark burgundy at the bottom (Low, 0). Among the three candidate states: Delaware (DE) is pale yellow (near the High end, ~100), Georgia (GA) is dark burgundy (near the Low end, ~0), and Rhode Island (RI) is gray (not on the scale, likely missing data). Therefore, DE has the highest prevalence among the candidates and should be routed to the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Delaware (DE) prevalence detail for routine monitoring
